paper_id: JTangSynergy 3.0_ A framework and software tool for integrating cross-organizational applications
title: JTangSynergy 3.0: A Framework and Software Tool for Integrating Cross-Organizational Applications
motivation: 传统ESB产品在跨组织场景下安全策略与异构数据服务支持不足
problem_framing: 跨组织大规模应用管理及异构数据服务集成的两个挑战
key_insight: 领域控制器可协调不同域间的安全策略，实现跨组织异构应用互操作
method_signature: 基于领域的跨组织ESB框架，包含领域控制器与CO-ESB容器集群
evaluation_criteria: 杭州电子政务集成项目，每年服务约五百万市民，人力成本降75%
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Most ESB products make simplified assumptions about security and heterogeneity requirements
evidence_for_taste: few of them can meet the above cross-organization EAI requirements
autonomous evolution of heterogeneous data services
different security, privacy, and confidentiality policies for different projects
thinking_moves: 将跨组织EAI问题拆解为分布式环境管理+异构数据服务集成两个维度
从现有ESB产品的局限性出发定位研究空间
用真实电子政务场景验证框架可行性而非仅做原型演示
通过量化指标（5百万市民/年、20%效率提升、75%成本降低）论证实用价值
cites_own_work: Yin J.W., Chen H.W. et al. A Dependable ESB Framework for Service Integration (2009)
Shi D.C., Yin J.W. et al. JTangPS: An RDF-based Publish/Subscribe System (2007)
extraction_notes: paper提供完整方法论描述但具体实现细节偏少，evaluation通过电子政务案例给出量化指标
